records.found: On 2026-11-07 the ZEUS trial of ziltivekimab (interleukin-6 antibody, 6,376 people) was presented at the American Heart Association meeting in Chicago and published in the New England Journal of Medicine: heart attacks, strokes and cardiovascular deaths were 17.6% against 17.7% on placebo (hazard ratio 0.99), with more serious infections and clots on the drug. This turns the company announcement of 2026-07-31 into a peer-reviewed second mark against anti-inflammatory heart treatment beside CLEAR SYNERGY, which a careful person would weigh as slightly lowering odds of wide use of such drugs on the earliest dates; it does not affect colchicine's approval.

findings.what: NEJM paper 'Interleukin-6 Inhibition with Ziltivekimab for Atherosclerotic Disease' (doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2612126); Crossref lists online 2026-11-07. Primary result negative.
